description: This file defines error handling and macro utilities for CUDA-related operations in PyTorch, including error checking for cuDNN, cuBLAS, cuSPARSE, cuDSS, cuSolver, and NVRTC, with support for ROCm fallback.

classes.name: CuDNNError
classes.description: Custom error class for cuDNN errors, inherits from c10::Error.

methods.name: AT_CUDNN_FRONTEND_CHECK
methods.description: Checks the result of a cuDNN frontend operation, throws CuDNNError if not good.

methods.name: AT_CUDNN_CHECK_WITH_SHAPES
methods.description: Wrapper for AT_CUDNN_CHECK with shape info.

methods.name: AT_CUDNN_CHECK
methods.description: Checks cuDNN status, throws error with message if not successful.

methods.name: TORCH_CUDABLAS_CHECK
methods.description: Checks cuBLAS operation status, throws error if failed.

methods.name: cusparseGetErrorString
methods.description: Returns error string for cusparseStatus_t errors.

methods.name: TORCH_CUDASPARSE_CHECK
methods.description: Checks cuSPARSE operation status, throws error if failed.

methods.name: cudssGetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns error message for cuDSS errors.

methods.name: TORCH_CUDSS_CHECK
methods.description: Checks cuDSS status, throws error with message if failed.

methods.name: cusolverGetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns error message for cuSolver errors.

methods.name: hipsolverGetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns error message for hipsolver errors.

methods.name: TORCH_CUSOLVER_CHECK
methods.description: Checks cuSolver or hipsolver status, throws error with message if failed.

methods.name: AT_CUDA_CHECK
methods.description: General macro for CUDA API error checking.

methods.name: AT_CUDA_DRIVER_CHECK
methods.description: Checks CUDA driver API calls for errors.

methods.name: AT_CUDA_NVRTC_CHECK
methods.description: Checks NVRTC API calls for errors, with special handling for error code 7.
